claims: El Niño conditions are expected to develop by summer 2026.
There is a 62% chance of El Niño emerging during June-August 2026 and persisting through the end of 2026.
ENSO is currently in a neutral phase.
A transition to El Niño is anticipated for the summer of 2026.
The likelihood of a transition to El Niño is increasing to around 40% by May-July 2026.
There is a 1-in-3 chance of a "strong" El Niño developing between October and December 2026.
